renames.evidence: objdump: called only from Com_EventLoop sites 0x0806196d and 0x08061a78 with (netadr, msg). Tests msg->cursize>3 and first dword==-1 then calls 0x0809594e (SV_ConnectionlessPacket); otherwise MSG_BeginReading, reads sequence and qport (0x080683f2 & 0xffff), loops svs.clients matching address/qport and runs Netchan_Process. This is exactly the Q3 SV_PacketEvent. Old name was a merge-collision artefact.

objdump: sole caller 0x08095bde sits in SV_ConnectionlessPacket after a Q_stricmp against rodata 0x0814b6e0 which is the string 'v'. Body loops clients (stride 0xb1064), matches address (0x080b..) and qport (+0x6e6dc), prints 'SV_ReadPackets: fixing up a translated port' (0x0814b540) on mismatch, then dispatches to the voice parsers 0x0809c3c6 (state<=3) or 0x0809c2ee (state>3). Name SV_ReadPackets is a Q3-style string leak shared with the real packet event and misleading.
